facts.business: GHCL Textiles Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of textiles, including cotton yarn and home textiles, with operations at Madurai and Manaparai units in Tamil Nadu.
key_risks: Commodity price risk (cotton exposure of ₹806.27 crore with no hedging through derivatives)
Foreign exchange risk on import/export exposures
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
